messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — Severity P2: Increased runtime latency & 5xx after recently started deploy (rollout slice 3). Alerts: response_p95 > 1.2s, 5xx rate ~0.8%. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-deploy-regression.md @ryan-oncall tagged
ryan-oncall: Oncall responding — joining. timeline? any customer-facing errors reported?
emily-sre: Started ~22:10 UTC. Canary (10%) OK; rollout slice 3 (us-west-2a) shows spike. Observed pattern: kernel selection fallback to slower kernel + batch queueing. Logs sample:
```
[22:12:34] batcher.cpp: enqueue_delay=48ms backlog=320
[22:12:35] runtime.cpp: kernel_select: fallback=quant-kernel-v1 reason=kernel_oom
[22:12:36] rpc.cpp: latency p95=1220ms p99=2.6s
```
maria-runtime: rollout slice 3 had `slice_optimizer` feature flag enabled (new optimization). Can confirm kernel_fallback events correlate with that slice.
josh-product: Support: Acme Corp reported timeouts and slow responses ~22:15. They saw intermittent 504s.
ryan-oncall: Thanks. Quick mitigation options: flip flag for that slice, scale batcher, or rollback slice. Which is fastest?
emily-sre: Fastest is flip the flag for the affected slice. That removes the new code path causing kernel pressure. Command to flip (prod):
```
./ffctl toggle --flag slice_optimizer --env prod --scope rollout_slice_3 --off
```
And increase batcher workers temporarily:
```
kubectl -n runtime scale deploy/batcher --replicas=10
```
I can run both.
ryan-oncall: Do it. Also tag support and customer success. @josh-product escalate if they ask for ETA.
emily-sre: Toggling flag now...
emily-sre: `./ffctl` returned OK. Flag off for rollout_slice_3. Scaling batcher now.
incident-bot: Action logged: feature flag change by emily-sre @ 22:18 UTC; scaled batcher replicas -> 10.
emily-sre: Observing metrics — backlog down from 320 -> 40 in ~90s. p95 trending down to 260ms. 5xx rate falling.
maria-runtime: kernel_fallback events dropping off on affected nodes. Canary unchanged.
ryan-oncall: Good. Any reason not to roll back the full rollout to previous image?
emily-sre: Safe to rollback if product wants full revert. The immediate fix (flag off) stabilizes, but the new optimizer still has edge-case memory pressure. I recommend rollback for rollout_slice_3 until we finish root cause.
josh-product: Support notified Acme Corp with ETA ~30m. They're asking for rollback if we can't give firm ETA.
ryan-oncall: For safety, let's rollback the slice rollout to previous configuration and start a controlled rollout after fixes. Maria, can you trigger the rollback for slice 3?
maria-runtime: Initiating rollback for rollout_slice_3 -> previous revision. Command: `./deployctl rollback --slice rollout_slice_3 --to-revision rev_2026_06_12_1`
maria-runtime: Rollback applied. Routing traffic back to stable variant.
incident-bot: Deploy event recorded: rollback rollout_slice_3 by maria-runtime @ 22:22 UTC.
emily-sre: Metrics after rollback: p95 = 180ms, 5xx ~ baseline. No further kernel_fallbacks in last 3 minutes.
ryan-oncall: Monitoring for 30m. If metrics stay green, we'll close paging. Prepare postmortem and include failure mode (optimizer caused kernel OOMs -> kernel fallback -> batch queuing spike).
josh-product: I'll follow up with Acme Corp and CC support.
emily-sre: Follow-ups: capture heap/kernel profiling from affected nodes, add guardrails in `slice_optimizer` (fallback threshold), add e2e test for batch pressure.
ryan-oncall: Handoff to emily-sre for deeper RCA and to maria-runtime for deploy/process notes. I'll mark incident as mitigated. Please file incident ticket and link here.
pagerduty: Incident status -> MITIGATED (actions taken: feature-flag-off, rollback, scaled batcher). Escalation cleared.
ryan-oncall: Closing hands-off: mitigation succeeded, rollback completed, customer impact limited to ~12m spike for a subset of region slices; Acme affected briefly. Postmortem next steps assigned. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
